researchExperiences.title: Graduate Researcher -- Fe-Ni Sulfide Electrocatalysts (DFT, MLIP & MD)
researchExperiences.organization: The Pennsylvania State University (MMT Group, Advisor: Dr. Nelson Y. Dzade)
bullets: Computed surface stability, electronic structure, and reaction thermodynamics across 30+ active sites via spin-polarized DFT and AIMD for kinetics-informed HER/OER mechanisms.
Fine-tuned FairChem and MACE suite MLIPs with uncertainty quantification to drive GPU-accelerated classical MD (LAMMPS) for explicit interfacial solvation.

researchExperiences.title: Graduate Researcher -- SrNb2O6 Photocatalysts & Multi-MLIP Screening
researchExperiences.organization: The Pennsylvania State University (MMT Group, Advisor: Dr. Nelson Y. Dzade)
bullets: Screen-doped oxide photocatalysts across 100+ active site combinations, mapping 11 reaction mechanisms and transition state structures via DFT.
Built active-learning MLIP screening and MD pipelines integrating Matbench/CatBench-aligned validation and automated VASP verification.

researchExperiences.title: Lead Author -- Rational Electrocatalyst Design Review (Small, 2026)
researchExperiences.organization: The Pennsylvania State University (Materials & Minerals Theory Group)
bullets: Synthesized synergistic DFT, MLIP, and experimental design rules for durable green hydrogen water electrolysis catalysts (Small, DOI: 10.1002/smll.202511010).

researchExperiences.title: Undergraduate Researcher -- ML-Driven Catalyst Design (OCM Reaction)
researchExperiences.organization: CSIR - Indian Institute of Chemical Technology (Advisor: Dr. Sumana Chenna)
bullets: Trained supervised ML regressors and an optimizable decision tree on 300+ experimental OCM catalyst records in MATLAB, reaching 83.3% test accuracy.

researchExperiences.title: Undergraduate Researcher -- Photoelectrochemical & Microbial Fuel Cells
